title: Task
description: One atomic, independently-verifiable unit emitted by the hardener. Task granularity bounds the CPU cost of stage-4 mutation.

complexity.description: 1 = not confident one focused pass solves it; recurse if > 0.05

tier.description: routing hint; the router picks the model

solution_corridor.description: sibling-leaf corridors MUST NOT overlap, so survivors localize to one task

acceptance_criteria.description: informal-but-testable statements; each must be observable and falsifiable; the specifier turns each into Gherkin

dependencies.description: ids of tasks that must complete first; edges must be acyclic across the hard_spec

mutation_budget.description: the asserted ceiling the stage-4 mutation run for THIS task must fit within; the prime decomposition lever

estimated_mutants.description: hardener's estimate; must be <= max when unit is mutants

decomposition_reason.description: set only when a node could not be made atomic within depth 5
